description: This header file contains auxiliary functions and class definitions related to cuDNN integration for quantized convolution and linear operations in PyTorch, including weight packing, tensor descriptor creation, and operator descriptors.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightCudnn
classes.description: Class for packed linear weights optimized for cuDNN quantized operations.

classes.name: PackedConvWeightCudnn
classes.description: Class for packed convolution weights optimized for cuDNN quantized operations.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the packed linear weight to an input tensor.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Applies the packed linear weight with ReLU activation.

methods.name: prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs weight tensors for cuDNN quantized operations.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the packed convolution weight to an input tensor.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Applies the packed convolution weight with ReLU activation.

methods.name: getRequantMultiplierTensor
methods.description: Creates a tensor filled with a requantization multiplier for broadcasting.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Determines memory alignment of a tensor in bytes.

methods.name: getTensorDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a cuDNN tensor descriptor from a tensor or shape/strides.

methods.name: getPointWiseMulDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a cuDNN pointwise multiplication descriptor.

methods.name: getPointWiseAddDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a cuDNN pointwise addition descriptor.

methods.name: getPointWiseReluDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a cuDNN pointwise ReLU descriptor.

methods.name: filterEngineConfigs
methods.description: Filters cuDNN engine configurations based on determinism and tensor core usage.
